_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "students" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "first_name" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "student_audience_changes" ("student_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "audience" TEXT NOT NULL, "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("student_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "seasons" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "closed_on" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "groups" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "season_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "audience" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_memberships" ("group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "groups" (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_date" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("group_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_records" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "season_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "audience" TEXT NOT NULL, "main_block_id" TEXT NULL, "recall_block_id" TEXT NULL, "sheet_id" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_presences" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_records (id), "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id", "student_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attempts" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "block_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "pass_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "potted" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assessments" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "concentration" INTEGER NOT NULL, "endurance" INTEGER NOT NULL, "frustration" INTEGER NOT NULL, "comment" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "planned_sessions" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "audience" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NULL, "sheet_id" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "block_acquisitions" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "block_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "alert_acknowledgements" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "block_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_attempt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_exports" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "exported_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (id = 1), "passes_required" INTEGER NOT NULL, "alert_threshold" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recall_stale_sessions" INTEGER NOT NULL, "group_failure_share_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL, "backup_reminder_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "season_archive_audiences" ("season_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "audience" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "presence_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "possible_presence_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "student_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("season_id", "audience"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "season_archive_exercises" ("season_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "audience" TEXT NOT NULL, "block_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "student_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "potted" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("season_id", "audience", "block_id", "exercise_number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "run_progress_entries" ("run_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "sheet_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "audience" TEXT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NULL, "step" INTEGER NOT NULL, "counts_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "checked_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "score_a" INTEGER NOT NULL, "score_b" INTEGER NOT NULL, "timer_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("run_key"));
CREATE INDEX attempts_by_student ON attempts (student_id)
CREATE INDEX attempts_by_session ON attempts (session_id)
CREATE INDEX assessments_by_student ON assessments (student_id)
CREATE INDEX acquisitions_by_student ON block_acquisitions (student_id)
CREATE INDEX acknowledgements_by_student ON alert_acknowledgements (student_id)
CREATE INDEX run_progress_by_group ON run_progress_entries (group_id)
CREATE INDEX run_progress_by_record ON run_progress_entries (record_id)
